cohort: The study included 100 women with spontaneous preterm delivery (between 24 weeks and 36 weeks and 6 days gestation) as cases and 100 women with normal delivery as controls, all from the west of Iran.
finding: There was a significant relationship between Gardnerella vaginalis bacteria and spontaneous preterm delivery, while other investigated bacterial infections (Chlamydia trachomatis, Neisseria gonorrhea, Listeria monocytogenes, Mycoplasma genitalium) showed no significant association.
gest_age: Cases: 24 weeks to less than 37 weeks; Controls: normal delivery (implying term).
